Taking a conservative median average of **400 spots** per individual to account for calves (who have fewer but proportional spots) and species variation yields a reliable baseline.

$$120,000 \text{ giraffes} \times 400 \text{ spots/giraffe} = 48,000,000 \text{ spots}$$
